cause: NEXY.ai advanced repeatedly by cooperating chats while Railway source identity variables referenced prior SHA/tree snapshots
violation_prevented: No stale validation result was promoted as proof for a newer HEAD
impact: Latest fixes committed but not all have exact-SHA full validation evidence yet

prevention: pin validation to immutable commit/branch or dedicated service when resource limits permit
never attribute an older passing run to a newer commit
